sandbox.docker.description: The Docker program sandboxes run with, and any arguments before each command (docker --context <name> for another engine). docker is looked for on PATH, then where Docker Desktop installs it.

sandbox.registryMirror.description: Where official images (ubuntu, debian, alpine, ...) are pulled from instead of Docker Hub, which limits anonymous pulls: mirror.gcr.io/library or public.ecr.aws/docker/library. Empty: Docker Hub. Images with a namespace or registry of their own are pulled as named.

sandbox.defaultCpus.description: Processors a sandbox may use when its definition does not say (cpus).

sandbox.defaultMemoryGiB.description: Memory a sandbox may use, in GiB, when its definition does not say (memoryGiB).

sandbox.idleStopMinutes.description: A running sandbox nothing ran in for this long is stopped (its files stay; the next run starts it in a second). 0: never.

sandbox.parallelRuns.description: How many sandboxes a validation runs at once. Emulated platforms are processor-heavy.

sandbox.images.description: Operating systems to add to the catalog, each as the catalog lists them: {id, title, family, packageManager (apt, dnf, apk, pacman, zypper), versions: [{version, image, platforms, default}]}. One with a shipped id replaces it.
